channel.title: AKTUAL MEDIA CHANNEL NAIROBI — AKTUAL MEDIA
channel.description: A daily review of local media with a link to every original. The review describes how the story was headlined and what to check before drawing a conclusion; the claims of the sources are not our claims.

item.title: Review: AWARD launches programme to support 47 women plant breeders across Africa
item.description: The programme seeks to address underrepresentation of women in plant breeding and improve the adoption of new crop varieties among women smallholder farmers. The post AWARD launches programme to support 47 women plant breeders across Africa appeared first on KBC Digital .

item.title: Review: MP Recall: National Assembly Approve One-Third Voter Threshold, Bill Heads to Senate for concurrence
item.description: National Assembly has approved a one-third voter-concurrence threshold for recalling MPs and a simple-majority rule for recall by-elections, with the Elections Amendment Bill returning to the Senate for consideration of the changes before mediation.

item.title: Review: Ruto: Africa must finance its own development
item.description: Africa must take greater responsibility for financing its development by strengthening its own financial institutions, President William Ruto has said.
